findings.message:
[P2] Preserve Tech Week loopback development origins

Excluding this client from the development-origin fallback also rejects loopback HTTP, so the documented Tech Week local request in `README.md` using `origin=http://localhost:8788` and `/auth.html` now returns `invalid_origin`; `docs/DECISIONS.md` also states that registered clients retain local-network development origins. If local Tech Week development remains supported, allow the loopback fallback or explicitly configure its development origins while continuing to reject non-loopback HTTP and arbitrary hosts.

src/auth_config.ts:273-279

summary: The exact-allowlist checks work for configured Tech Week entries and the tests cover attacker HTTPS and HTTP origins, but excluding the client from the development fallback also removes documented loopback development support.

evidence: src/auth_config.ts:273-290 skips the dynamic HTTP development-origin and redirect fallbacks for `techweek-2026-event-picker`, leaving exact configured allowlist membership.
src/config_test.ts:38-50 configures only HTTPS origins and callbacks, and lines 163-168 assert that the fixture contains no plain-HTTP configuration.
src/config_test.ts:169-184 verifies every configured target is accepted while attacker HTTPS and HTTP origins and redirects are rejected.
